title: Umenyiwe ku-Vaultara
intro: I-Vaultara ilandelela amadokhumenti akho futhi ikutshele ngaphambi kokuphelelwa.
nocode: Lesi sixhumanisi asinayo ikhodi. Cela umngane wakho akuthumelele futhi.
note: Faka i-app bese udala i-akhawunti yakho. Bese uvula Iphrofayela, uthinte Mema abangane bese ufaka ikhodi phakathi nezinsuku ezingu-14. Nobabili nithola inyanga eyodwa ye-Premium yamahhala uma i-imeyili yakho iqinisekisiwe futhi wengeza irekhodi lakho lokuqala.
